deaf-talks.vercel.app github.com/tinothecreator/Deaf-Talks

Music: Sascha Ende, ende.app (CC BY 4.0) · Vol. 12 · looped and faded

A home for South African Sign Language stories, shared with care.
The project addresses access to SASL stories and control over how they are shared.
Deaf-Talks · working product name: SignStories · deaf-talks.vercel.app
Sign-up offers Learner and Storyteller. Teacher promotion is managed by the team.
Real screen recording · demo account · credentials redacted
MP4, WebM or MOV · the upload begins privately
Visible caption: “Hello, how are you. I respect you and I support you.”
The selected demo video is 25.4 MB; progress reaches 100%.
The recording confirms: “Your story is saved as a private draft. Only you can view it.”
Tagging is implemented in the repo; this step is explained because it was not recorded.
Publication requires consent, nonprivate usage, a caption, credit and 3–5 valid signs.
Login entry is omitted to keep account details private.
Real demo account footage · published stories at /stories
Story caption copied from the app; no new translation of the signing has been added.
Recorded sign list; the final frame is held for reading. Practice is a roadmap feature.
Timestamp navigation is verified in the repo; a completed seek is not shown in this recording.
Teacher account view is held for reading. Review submission is excluded from this walkthrough.
Today’s walkthrough shows account access and browsing. Human feedback is listed under what’s next.
Withdrawal hides the story from others and prevents new playback links.
An already issued link may work until expiry. No download button; playback cannot prevent copying.
Text-only AI belongs in the roadmap. People judge signing.
No AI recognition, generation, grading or translation of sign language from video.
